Na Decathlon, nosso time de tecnologia tem como missão propor e atender às necessidades das equipes de negócio com soluções que sejam funcionais, seguras, inovadoras e com arquitetura sólida.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Analista de Sistemas Sênior para se juntar a nós, com o objetivo de desenhar e implementar soluções de TI de alta qualidade, alinhadas às estratégias do grupo e às melhores práticas do mercado. Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, gosta de pensar estrategicamente e quer contribuir ativamente para a evolução de produtos digitais, esta vaga é para você!


Main responsibilities

Quais são as principais responsabilidades?

  • Liderar de forma independente a construção e a implementação de soluções de TI, desde a análise funcional e definição da arquitetura até a implantação e o suporte.
  • Garantir que a arquitetura das soluções esteja alinhada às diretrizes corporativas, visando escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e performance.
  • Assegurar que as soluções propostas satisfaçam as necessidades dos usuários e se encaixem na estratégia de negócio da Decathlon.
  • Definir, documentar e defender as escolhas de arquitetura para novos projetos e evoluções.
  • Transformar as necessidades funcionais dos clientes em produtos de TI, realizando análises técnicas e funcionais detalhadas.
  • Orientar e acompanhar a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir a correta aplicação da arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir o bom funcionamento das soluções em produção, trazendo as correções necessárias para uma implementação de qualidade.
  • Analisar e diagnosticar problemas complexos em nível de arquitetura, propondo soluções eficazes e duradouras.
  • Comunicar de forma eficaz as decisões de arquitetura para as partes interessadas, tanto técnicas quanto não técnicas.
  • Atuar tecnicamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento em questões de arquitetura, como referência e mentor.

Requirements and skills

O que você precisa ter?

  • Visão Estratégica: Conhecimento para compreender e aplicar as estratégias de mercado e de TI da Decathlon, contribuindo para sua construção.
  • Concepção e Arquitetura de Software: Experiência em traduzir requisitos não-funcionais (performance, segurança, escalabilidade) em decisões de arquitetura.
  • Capacidade de selecionar os padrões de arquitetura, tecnologias e ferramentas mais adequadas para cada solução.
  • Habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas modulares, coesas e com baixo acoplamento, promovendo a reutilização de componentes.
  • Prática com a realização de provas de conceito (PoCs) para validar abordagens arquiteturais.
  • Aconselhamento e Relacionamento: Capacidade de desenvolver uma relação de proximidade com clientes e usuários para identificar necessidades e propor soluções adequadas.
  • Habilidade para aconselhar equipes de desenvolvimento e negócio sobre as melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolvimento e Qualidade: Experiência prática em ações de desenvolvimento e configuração.
  • Capacidade de revisar código e entregas da equipe para garantir a conformidade com a arquitetura definida.
  • Segurança: Conhecimento para incorporar requisitos de segurança desde as fases iniciais do desenho da arquitetura (Security by Design).
  • Capacidade de definir e garantir a implementação de controles de segurança como autenticação, autorização e criptografia.
  • Liderança e Comunicação: Habilidade para liderar tecnicamente equipes, coordenar recursos e influenciar stakeholders sem ter uma ligação hierárquica direta.
  • Comunicação clara para apresentar propostas de arquitetura e documentar soluções.
  • Inovação: Manter-se atento(a) às evoluções técnicas e tecnológicas do mercado para oferecer soluções inovadoras e eficientes.

O que esperamos dos nossos jogadores?

  • Acredite nos prazeres e nos benefícios do esporte;
  • Seja orientado à ação e desafio;
  • Apaixonado pela satisfação do cliente;
  • Valorize o jogo coletivo e trabalho em equipe;
  • Seja proativo, espírito empreendedor;
  • Saiba trabalhar com responsabilidade e autonomia;
  • Tenha coragem na tomada de decisão;
  • Criatividade e adaptação nas situações adversas.

Additional information

Nossos Benefícios

  • DecaPack: Remuneração mensal, vale-transporte, vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação, assistência médica e odontológica, Dra. Decah (coach nutricional e esportivo, telepsicologia e telemedicina), seguro de vida, auxílio farmácia (Epharma), premiação mensal, participação nos lucros e resultados.
  • Trabalho híbrido: Três dias de home office na semana.
  • Mães, Pais e Futuros esportistas: Licença Maternidade estendida para 180 dias e licença paternidade estendida para 20 dias.
  • Paixão pelo esporte: Auxílio esporte (Gympass ou Total Pass) e desconto de 30% em produtos das marcas próprias Decathlon.
  • Para o seu futuro: Participação acionária, e previdência privada.
  • Universidade corporativa para treinamentos e desenvolvimento dos nossos esportistas.

Acreditamos que, para o maior número de pessoas ter acesso à prática esportiva, a sustentabilidade e a diversidade são fundamentais. Portanto, todas as nossas vagas são aplicáveis para todas as pessoas sem qualquer tipo de distinção. Vamos juntos!

O que procuramos?
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em gestão de mudança organizacional (Change Management) para atuar nas ações do ciclo de Planejamento Estratégico de Tecnologia (TI 2030), com foco inicial nas iniciativas de evolução da resiliência digital da empresa. Esta posição exige forte capacidade de articulação com stakeholders, visão sistêmica, habilidade de comunicação com alta liderança e domínio na criação de materiais executivos e instrumentos de monitoramento do sucesso da mudança; além de experiência em cenários de transformação tecnológica (ex: adoção de DevSecOps, Agilidade, etc) em cenários de ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais fim a fim.
Escopo do Programa
O programa de Resiliência Digital visa elevar a maturidade tecnológica da organização, atuando nas seguintes frentes:

  • Redução de débito técnico e obsolescência;
  • Tratamento de vulnerabilidades tecnológicas;

Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de mudança em programas de transformação digital, tecnológica ou organizacional.
  • Atuação com públicos técnicos (ex: engenharia, segurança, arquitetura) e não técnicos (ex: negócio, liderança).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como PROSCI/ADKAR, Lean Change ou similares.
  • Habilidade comprovada em produção de apresentações executivas para níveis gerenciais e C-level.
  • Experiência na criação de indicadores para monitoramento da mudança e tomada de decisão.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis, DevOps e práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.
Habilidades Comportamentais Esperadas
  • Comunicação clara, empatia e escuta ativa.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos em linguagem acessível e influenciar diferentes perfis de stakeholders.
  • Organização e disciplina para atuação em múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Proatividade e autonomia, com foco em entregas de alto impacto.
  • Possuir visão sistêmica de estruturas e processos de tecnologia.
  • Visão estratégica, poder de síntese com capacidade de executar no detalhe.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações: PROSCI, PMP, Agile Change, Lean Change Management.

title: CX Quality Senior Manager
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: you have experience in leading and developing teams.
  • Customer Experience (CX) and Quality Assurance (QA) experience: Proven experience in monitoring CX operations, with a focus on efficiency and quality improvement, including quality monitoring, calibration, and performance management.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: You are data savvy and have experience in improving customer experiences.
  • CX & Quality Expertise: Proven experience in Customer Experience (CX) with a track record of driving quantifiable improvements in key metrics like CSAT, NPS, and CES.
  • Advanced Data Analysis: Highly proficient in Excel (PivotTables, Charts, statistical functions) for large, complex datasets, ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and experience in SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Python as a plus.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Methodologies: Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, COPC or other quality certifications a strong advantage.
  • AI Enthusiast: Eager to explore and apply Artificial Intelligence to enhance quality processes and agent performance.
  • Strategic & Influential Leader: Strong leadership presence, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders while anticipating future trends and developing long-term strategies.
  • Data-driven and Analytical: Leverages a robust analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Deeply dedicated to enhancing the customer experience and influencing others to prioritize customer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Explains complex changes clearly to diverse audiences, concisely summarizing data and insights, telling compelling stories, and presenting impactful recommendations.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues and implements solutions to prevent negative customer impacts. Able to turn incomplete or ambiguous inputs into clear action plans.
  • Highly Collaborative: Works effectively with various teams and influences stakeholders, building strong relationships across departments.
  • Adaptable & Dynamic: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and readily adapts to changing business needs and priorities.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proficiency in English and leadership experienceare mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic marketing manager to lead the development, execution and management of brand initiatives for the 99 brand for the platform's driver partners. This role requires a creative and analytical professional capable of creating compelling brand moments, driving engagement across multiple channels and ensuring brand consistency across supply-side, core business and brand actions.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for brand performance and customer engagement, we invite you to apply and drive the future of mobility with us.

Role Responsibilities

  • Campaign planning and execution

  • Strategize, plan, implement, optimize and report on the annual calendar of campaigns in organic and paid media channels (offline, digital, social, partnerships and PR initiatives).

  • Collaborate with the creative, media and product teams to develop innovative campaigns that increase brand presence and platform partner driver engagement.

  • Measure and analyze campaign performance, leveraging insights to continuously optimize brand strategies.

  • Cross-functional leadership

  • Lead the planning and development of marketing actions for partner drivers, in collaboration with the other verticals in the area, to build and evolve 99's brand perception and business results.

  • Manage brand image and initiatives, in collaboration with the government affairs and corporate communications teams.

Work closely with internal stakeholders to align on objectives, share insights, and promote a consistent brand voice across all touch points with the platform's driver partners.

Role Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing management, preferably within delivery, tech, mobility, or consumer-focused industries.

  • Proven experience in developing and executing marketing strategies, user journey and promotional campaigns.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

  • Experience in trade marketing, business collaboration, and campaign management.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple stakeholders.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

Valorizamos ações assertivas, orientadas para a eficiência e embasadas pelo know-how . Buscamos novas formas de olhar e encarar desafios, sempre com uma postura resiliente e perseverante. Gerimos nossos negócios de forma socialmente responsável. Temos o compromisso de desenvolver soluções de tecnologia e infraestrutura para a transformação digital de empresas, cidades e nações de forma eficiente e sustentável para o planeta.

Vamos juntos #Begreen nessa transformação?

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Professional Areas Information Technology

Louis Dreyfus Company is a leading merchant and processor of agricultural goods. Our activities span the entire value chain from farm to fork, across a broad range of business lines, we leverage our global reach and extensive asset network to serve our customers and consumers around the world. Structured as a matrix organization of six geographical regions and eight platforms, Louis Dreyfus Company is active in over 100 countries and employs approximately 17,000 people globally.

LDC is pursuing an exciting digital journey, driving industrialization of IT delivery, and innovating with cutting-edge technology (Cloud, AI and Machine Learning, Agile DevOps/ SecOps, data mesh, etc.).

Our DT&A (Digital Technology and Analytics) strategy has already achieved significant value driving innovation, efficiency, agility, and speed to market. Our research and BI capabilities have driven superior decision making, but there is much more still to be achieved and we need great people to make this happen.
Within the global DT&A organization, you will be offered unique projects with opportunities to grow and develop in a collaborative, fast-moving, vibrant, and entrepreneurial spirit.

Our DT&A Front Office Team is looking for a Senior Business Analyst for our Front Office Services line to be based in Sao Paulo or Santos, Brazil.
As part of a dynamic and agile team, you will act as change booster and lead business process transformation in the domain, working on our International Trade and Execution Front Office solution (ATLAS Grains & Oilseeds) and modernization of regional Front Office solutions.
These solutions are the cornerstone of our trading systems. Interlinking all our core business functions (Trading, Execution, Accounting, Treasury, Controlling), with a global presence spread all around the world, accessing the application 24/7.

Job Description

  • Users support: Analyze and troubleshoot system issues, provide training and support to users. Liaise with network administrators, system analysts, and software engineers to assist in resolving problems with software products or company software systems.
  • Actively escalates issues to Service Manager and Software Developer Lead.
  • Gather and translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications.
  • Actively participate in ATLAS Deployment/Rollout activities as per the project requirements.
  • System Configuration, User trainings and hyper care support activities for Deployment/Rollout projects.
  • Analyze, Clean-up and Migrate Master Data and Transactional data from Legacy to Target systems.

Specifically oversee:

  • Support: Part of the global Support team that is required to provide Support expertise on complex functional topics. Act as the escalation contact to regional Support teams within the same time-zone and liaise with them when required to resolve user reported functional issues.
  • For issues requiring development changes, categorize them based on impact/urgency and re-assign to respective development teams, while at the same time identify suitable workarounds that can be done in the application to unblock users.
  • Requirements Management: requirements gathering, understanding and documentation of business requirements.
  • Functional and technical Specifications: Review and finalize functional specifications. Refine with Dev team.
  • Testing: Provide guidance and support the regional and global business during the test campaigns.
  • Process Improvement: Identification of process gaps and providing improvement plans to the Build and Run processes.
Experience
  • 5-7 (plus) years of strong technical or operational experience in financial or trading systems and a successful history of project plan completion
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business or computer science
  • Experience analyzing, implementing, and supporting enterprise business systems.
  • Experience in participating in cross-functional project teams’ environment; ability to perform in various roles from individual contributor to a leadership role; ability to contribute to planning, organization and managing of project teams using a structured delivery methodology.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other business organizations; successful experience in working with diverse groups of people in a problem-solving environment.
  • International multi-cultural environment. Experience working in a global team spread across the world.
  • Business analysis, story writing, backlog management.
  • Incident analysis and incident management.

title: Senior Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer
description:
Job Description

At IPS, you will apply your knowledge, skills, and passion to make a difference in the lives of people, solving complex challenges related to pharmaceutical, biotech, and animal health research and manufacturing facilities. We are looking for a talented Senior Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.


In this role, you will work independently on various projects as assigned by a Project Manager or group leader. You will also play a role in the entire design process including but not limited to preliminary assessments, concept creation, design, problem resolution, and customer and vendor accessibility. Additionally, you may work on several concurrent projects and at times may assist as a technical expert on a specialized design. Fluency in English is mandatory
What You'll Do

  • Assign and review the work of the project design team.
  • Check the progress of work and alert the Project Manager to changes in scope or additional services.
  • Attend pre-bid meetings and assist the project team in evaluating commercial proposals.
  • Assess the requirements of a project, break a project into tasks, and work with a Project Manager to determine the scope of work, budget, and staffing.
  • Write the scope of work for plumbing and fire protection designs based on preliminary reviews and meetings with the clients.
  • Develop design concepts and prepare documents during the design development phase.
  • Correct and update design documents.
  • Develops solutions to design problems.
  • Prepare engineering studies and schematic designs for new systems and analyze the operation of existing systems.
  • Use computer-aided design technologies to develop sketches, drawings, and construction documents.
  • Review drawings and documents to ensure compliance with company design and production standards.
  • Work with equipment suppliers/vendors to obtain the necessary information needed for design completion.
  • Interacts with clients regularly to secure scope and design intent.
  • Ensure acceptable levels of quality and check for coordination of work to ensure documents reflect design intent and necessary coordination.
  • Coordinate all aspects of project document completion within the company and externally with clients and other design professionals.
  • Coordinate design work with related engineering disciplines.
  • Attend job and construction meetings and participate in the coordination of the work.
  • Contribute to annual performance reviews for assigned staff.
  • Assist in the education and development of design staff and act as a resource for design questions.

Come join a caring, nimble team that delivers world-class designs for our pharmaceutical clients and take your career to new heights!


Qualifications & Requirements
  • 10+ years of previous Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineering and Design experience.
  • Bachelor of Engineering Degree from an accredited University.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE).
  • Has previous experience working for an Architectural and Engineering firm (A&E).
  • Is proficient in the use of computers for design and understands CAD operations.
  • Has knowledge of all aspects of plumbing and fire protection systems; including Sanitary and Vent Systems, Storm Systems, Process Waste Systems, Lab and Vent Systems, Domestic Water Systems, Process and Lab Gas Systems, Sprinkler Design, and Wet/Dry/Pre Action Systems.
  • Is able to produce calculations for the above systems.
  • Has a demonstrated ability to manage projects, problem solve, and communicate effectively to all key personnel and time manage.
  • Able to travel up to 25%.
  • Must have more than 5 years’ experience in pharmaceutical projects
  • Must be fluent in English
  • Must have experience in Revit, AutoCad plant 3D

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in process industries, particularly in the Life Sciences sector (pharmaceutical, biotech, or similar).
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) to support teams in Brazil and the USA.
  • Strong understanding of international codes and standards (e.g., ASME, ANSI, NFPA).

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. IPS, inclusive of its Enterprise entities, has over 3,500 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East. title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: AUXILIAR REFRIGERAÇÃO
description:
Job description

Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.


Main responsibilities

  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho.
  • Executar, sob orientação, atividades de instalação e manutenção corretiva e preventiva de equipamentos, válvulas e dispositivos de sistemas e conjuntos de refrigeração.
  • Efetuar, sob orientação, a manutenção, conserto, reparos e reformas em válvulas, tubulações, sistemas de ventilação, calefação e ar condicionado, medidores e outros dispositivos de sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Ler, interpretar e utilizar manuais, catálogos, tabelas e especificações técnicas, bem como ferramental e equipamentos específicos e especializados para execução dos serviços de refrigeração.
  • Fazer a instalação dos sistemas de refrigeração e auxiliares, em função de sua experiência e especialidade, bem como realizar reparos e ajustes nos motores destes sistemas.
  • Auxiliar em estudos e análises de funcionamento dos equipamentos de refrigeração, a fim de solucionar problemas de funcionamento.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e instalação de ar-condicionado em toda planta industrial.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva do sistema de refrigeração, ventilação e tubulações.
  • Auxiliar e executar, sob supervisão, em caso de adequações necessárias para o perfeito funcionamento dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios das atividades realizadas pelo Plano de Manutenção Operação e Controle (PMOC).
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes ao cargo, conforme solicitação do superior imediato
  • Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a tresponsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho.
  • Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia.
  • Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada.

Requirements and skills

Ensino fundamental completo;

Experiência na função.


Additional information

Vale alimentação; Plano de saúde (Unimed); Plano odontológico; Vale transporte; PPR; Gympass; Refeição na empresa.

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
About this role:

The Contract Specialist is responsible for the contract administration process for all Americas contracts. Additionally, they will monitor and ensure compliance with the contract process for all business units they support i.e., Sales, Deal Hub, Consulting, Events, etc.

What you'll do:

  • Effectively process incoming requests from departments for assistance (Sales, CFS, Controller, Deal Hub, Corporate Pricing, Contracts Negotiators, Corporate Legal, Consulting, Events, Client Compliance, etc.). Manage the team Outlook inbox by ensuring emails are prioritized by urgency and importance once approvals are received.

  • Manage all incoming Master and Order Agreements for 100% compliance (e.g., Research, Consulting, and Events business units). This includes, but is not limited to: 1. Input metadata into systems (ie Apttus), 2. Document comparison and confirm for approvals, 3. Process signature, & 4. Process for uploading into systems.

  • Signing authority for order agreements and 100% compliance with legal empowerment matrix.

  • Ensure compliance with Gartner corporate policy regarding document administration, including any non-standard items, such as legal term changes, non-standard SDs, non-standard pricing, and non-standard billing terms have been approved.

  • Execute any and all special ad hoc projects initiated to fulfill business requirements.

  • Collaborate with global manager and global team to seek continuous improvement & innovation to department processes.

  • Prepare instructive communications to and liaise with global Contracts Department, Client Financial Services, Sales teams in fulfilment of above responsibilities.

  • Support of Contract Manager in providing first line of support to Sales on all issues relating to sales contracts and requests for contracts, escalating to senior staff as required

  • Fair, honest, professional, friendly and collaborative approach with all stakeholders including remote team members and manager (Sales, Contract Negotiators, CFS, Corporate Legal, Client Compliance, etc.).

  • High work ethic and integrity.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • A minimum of 2-4 years’ experience dealing with contract matters, client legal & procurements departments, as well as with Sales organization interaction.

  • Maintain or obtain skills necessary to be proficient on department systems and document retrieval systems.

  • Excellent communication skills developed in a sales driven environment, including strong English skills (written and verbal)

  • Client-facing experience with commercial awareness.

  • Experience analyzing data (Excel or other data analytics tools) and advanced Microsoft Word skills.

  • Strong understanding of contracts.

  • Effective public speaking, organizational, prioritization and problem-solving skills.

  • Willingness to assume responsibility and adaptability for the role, while displaying a sense of urgency to the business.

  • Ability to work within a remote team (a multinational company experience would be preferred)

  • Gartner Core Values: Integrity, Objectivity, Results, No-Limits Mindset, Collaboration

description:
Job description

NÓS SOMOS A DOJO

Uma agência full service para a era hiperconectada.

Acreditamos que os kiddos - como chamamos carinhosamente as nossas pessoas colaboradoras - são a chave para fazer tudo acontecer, e - com a força coletiva - vamos mais longe e que as mudanças são sempre necessárias e bem-vindas. Em nosso espaço, estamos abertos para propor coisas novas, desafiar os padrões e progredir como nunca.

Nossa criatividade, estratégia e resultados são reconhecidos por marcas como Havaianas, ASICS, Prime Video, Camil, Lindt, Sony Pictures, Meta e também pelos prêmios TikTok Ad Awards, Prêmio Fornecedores L’Oréal, Effie, Clio Entertainment e El Ojo de Iberoamérica.

Crescemos 500% desde 2019 e buscamos mais um kiddo para construir mais coisas incríveis com a gente.

#VemPraDOJO


Main responsibilities

A pessoa Strategic Planning Assistant será responsável por apoiar a equipe de estratégia no desenvolvimento de insights, análises de mercado e recomendações estratégicas para clientes e projetos internos. Esta posição exige pensamento analítico, organização, curiosidade intelectual e habilidades de comunicação para traduzir dados e tendências em soluções acionáveis.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar na pesquisa e análise de tendências de mercado, comportamento do consumidor e concorrência;
  • Auxiliar na estruturação de apresentações estratégicas e materiais de suporte para clientes e equipes internas;
  • Coletar e interpretar dados de diferentes fontes (social listening, relatórios de mercado, pesquisas proprietárias, etc.);

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia orientada a desenvolver soluções customizadas para auxiliar nossos clientes a gerir suas frotas de forma eficiente. Nossa missão além de promover a melhoria nos processos logísticos dos nossos clientes é promover um ambiente desafiador a fim de incentivar o autoconhecimento e autodesenvolvimento adaptado as necessidades profissionais dos nossos colaboradores.

  • Atuar na gestão de riscos, controles internos e auditorias internas e externas;
  • Gerenciar as áreas de Contabilidade, Fiscal, Financeira, Tesouraria e Controladoria;

  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa, planejamento financeiro e orçamento, garantindo saúde financeira e sustentabilidade dos negócios;

  • Registro ativo no CRC;

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis (obrigatório);
  • Perfil analítico, resiliente com visão estratégica, senso de urgência e foco em resultados;
  • Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis, legislação fiscal, planejamento tributário e gestão financeira;
  • Experiência consolidada nas áreas Contábil, Fiscal e Controladoria, preferencialmente em empresas de médio ou grande porte.

title: Coordenação de Facilities
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, cujo propósito é proporcionar e viabilizar uma Justiça melhor e gerar mais confiança nas relações sociais através do acesso à informação.

Estamos caminhando para sermos reconhecidos como single source of truth para informações jurídicas e construir esse caminho não é trivial.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, cujo propósito é proporcionar e viabilizar uma Justiça melhor e gerar mais confiança nas relações sociais através do acesso à informação.

Estamos caminhando para sermos reconhecidos como single source of truth para informações jurídicas e construir esse caminho não é trivial.

Lidamos diariamente com problemas complexos que exigem pensamento crítico e analítico para propor soluções que nunca foram pensadas. Hoje estamos na casa das centenas de colaboradores espalhados em mais de 40 cidades no Brasil e fora. E a nossa sustentabilidade como empresa vai ser diretamente proporcional ao aumento da nossa densidade e diversidade de talentos com o crescimento desse time incrível que já temos.

Jusbrasil em números:

+ de 1,2 bi de documentos jurídicos de interesse público

+ de 1PB de dados na nossa infraestrutura de tecnologia

+ de 30 m de usuários

+ de 700 colaboradores

+ de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados

A pessoa que ocupar essa vaga fará parte do time de WorkX (Workplace Experience) do Jusbrasil. O time de WorkX é responsável por proporcionar a melhor experiência no ambiente de trabalho para todas as pessoas jusbrasileiras. Cuidamos da operação dos nossos hubs (escritórios), promovemos eventos, garantimos um home office bem estruturado e uma experiência digital incrível!

Nossa missão é inspirar paixão para construir valor para nossos usuários por meio de uma cultura orientada pela missão, proporcionando resultados excepcionais através de experiências contínuas e significativas. Trabalhamos para criar ambientes que impulsionem o engajamento e a conexão entre todos, tornando cada experiência única e alinhada com a cultura da empresa.

A Pessoa Coordenadora de Facilities será uma liderança estratégica e "mão na massa" , responsável pela gestão de todos os processos relacionados à infraestrutura física da empresa. Além de garantir a excelência operacional em nossa estrutura atual, você será a pessoa chave para conduzir uma transformação cultural no time de Facilities , elevando a eficiência, a qualidade dos serviços e a performance geral. Isso inclui a abertura de novos hubs, reformas, adequações às normas técnicas e aos pilares culturais da empresa, com foco na construção de ambientes que conectam pessoas e estimulam a performance organizacional.

  • Liderança e Transformação Cultural: Liderar e inspirar o time de Facilities a adotar uma cultura de alta performance, melhoria contínua e foco na execução. Atuar ativamente na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de processos, capacitação da equipe e implementação de novas metodologias de trabalho que elevem a eficiência operacional e a qualidade dos serviços prestados.
  • Gestão Estratégica de Facilities: Gerenciar todas as operações dos hubs e escritórios, garantindo a conformidade com as normas técnicas e legais aplicáveis, como acessibilidade, segurança e ergonomia. Implementar e acompanhar planos de manutenção preditiva e preventiva, buscando a excelência na infraestrutura e a redução de custos operacionais.
  • Otimização da Operação de Limpeza e Cozinha: Gerir a operação interna de limpeza e cozinha com um olhar crítico para a eficiência e a qualidade. Supervisionar a execução dos contratos de fornecedores, garantindo que os padrões de higiene, organização e produtividade sejam consistentemente mantidos, de acordo com as necessidades e expectativas do ambiente corporativo.
  • Gestão Executiva da Cozinha: Ser o responsável pelo processo operacional da cozinha, garantindo a eficiência, o alinhamento às normas técnicas e a melhoria contínua dos serviços. Implementar e auditar rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança alimentar e boas práticas, assegurando um serviço de alta qualidade e conformidade.
  • Excelência em Hospitalidade: Assegurar que o ambiente de trabalho seja não apenas acolhedor, mas também um catalisador de engajamento e produtividade. Isso inclui a organização de eventos internos, a recepção e o apoio durante o processo de integração dos novos colaboradores, sempre com foco em proporcionar experiências memoráveis e alinhadas à cultura do Jusbrasil.
  • Planejamento e Execução de Obras com Visão Estratégica: Coordenar o planejamento e a execução de obras e reformas, desde a concepção até a entrega, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo, orçamento e conforme as exigências estabelecidas. Aplicar uma visão executiva para antecipar necessidades futuras de infraestrutura e otimizar o uso dos espaços.
  • Compliance e Conformidade Regulatória: Garantir que todos os espaços estejam em conformidade com as normas de acessibilidade, segurança, ergonomia e saúde ocupacional, incluindo a adequação às normas de segurança e boas práticas de alimentação. Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as legislações pertinentes.
  • Gestão Orçamentária e Otimização de Custos: Elaborar e gerenciar o orçamento de facilities com rigor, buscando a otimização de custos e a eficiência na alocação de recursos. Realizar o controle financeiro de todos os projetos e despesas da área, apresentando relatórios claros e insights para a tomada de decisão.
  • Cultura e Engajamento Contínuo: Atuar como um(a) embaixador(a) da cultura do Jusbrasil, apoiando na implementação de iniciativas que promovam o bem-estar, o reconhecimento e a motivação dos colaboradores. Colaborar ativamente com o time de People e outros stakeholders para garantir um ambiente alinhado com a cultura organizacional e que estimule a performance.
  • Sustentabilidade e Inovação: Implementar e disseminar práticas sustentáveis dentro do ambiente de trabalho, buscando soluções inovadoras que contribuam para as metas de responsabilidade social e ambiental da empresa.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de facilities, com histórico de liderança de times e de projetos de transformação e otimização de processos.
  • Profundo conhecimento técnico e operacional de todos os fluxos e processos de facilities, com capacidade de "colocar a mão na massa" e resolver desafios operacionais.
  • Visão executiva e estratégica, com habilidade para planejar a longo prazo, antecipar necessidades de infraestrutura e propor soluções inovadoras que impactem positivamente a performance da empresa.
  • Conhecimento sólido em normas técnicas como NBR 9050 (2020), NBR 9077 (2021), NR 23 (2022), NR 24 (2019), NR 17, e outras regulamentações de segurança e ergonomia.
  • Sólida experiência em gerenciamento de contratos, negociação com fornecedores e gestão de relacionamento com prestadores de serviço.
  • Experiência robusta com planejamento, gestão e execução de obras e reformas, incluindo controle de cronograma, qualidade e orçamento.
  • Habilidade avançada em gestão de orçamento, controle de custos e análise de indicadores de performance.
  • Capacidade de liderança inspiradora e comprovada experiência em construir, desenvolver e motivar equipes multifuncionais, impulsionando a alta performance e a mudança cultural.
  • Conhecimento e vivência com ferramentas de gestão de facilities e software de planejamento.
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, construindo relacionamentos sólidos e eficazes.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Lean Six Sigma ou outras metodologias de melhoria contínua.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em sustentabilidade e práticas de economia circular aplicadas a ambientes corporativos.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão no Jusbrasil

Somos uma empresa que se preocupa em oferecer oportunidades iguais de crescimento a todos os nossos colaboradores, e que busca cada vez mais aumentar internamente a presença de grupos sub-representados, como mulheres, pessoas negras, pessoas da comunidade LGBTQIA+ e PCDs. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências são essenciais para um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, respeitoso e de alto impacto na sociedade, e temos orgulho em dizer que o Jusbrasil toma iniciativas internas e externas de fomento à Diversidade & Inclusão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Colaborar com usuários finais e stakeholders para identificar necessidades de dados e definir os requisitos para projetos de sistemas de análise.
  • Analisar processos e sistemas existentes, propondo automações e melhorias baseadas em dados.
  • Analisar requisitos e recursos técnicos (hardware e software) para projetar soluções robustas de coleta, armazenamento, análise e visualização de dados.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica detalhada das soluções propostas.

  • Desenvolver rotinas de integração e uniformização de dados, aderindo a padrões estabelecidos para possibilitar o cruzamento de informações e reduzir a redundância.
  • Assegurar a compatibilidade com dados preexistentes, promovendo a unificação das informações.
  • Monitorar o desempenho de aplicações de dados através de logs, painéis e outras ferramentas de diagnóstico.
  • Identificar gargalos de performance e implementar soluções como criação de índices, ajustes de configuração e proposição de melhorias ou aquisições de recursos.
  • Buscar a otimização do consumo de recursos e garantir tempos de resposta adequados aos usuários.
  • Apoiar a configuração de permissões e perímetros de acesso aos dados.
  • Colaborar na implementação de medidas de segurança para reduzir vulnerabilidades e na gestão de cópias de segurança.

  • Criar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica dos sistemas de dados, bancos de dados, processos e ativos relacionados, facilitando a consulta e o trabalho de outros técnicos da área.
  • Realizar pesquisas e avaliações de novas tecnologias, metodologias e atualizações que possam agregar valor aos sistemas existentes ou trazer benefícios para novos projetos de dados.
  • Monitorar continuamente os recursos tecnológicos utilizados nos processos de dados (servidores, bancos de dados, etc.) através de painéis de gerenciamento, métricas, indicadores, logs e testes, garantindo o bom desempenho, a disponibilidade e o uso eficiente dos recursos.

  • Lógica de programação, Linguagens e tecnologias para visualização e análise de dados (PowerBI desktop, PowerBI Pro), Linguagens e tecnologias para desenvolvimento de aplicações (Python, C#, R, PySpark), Levantamento de Requisitos,Desenvolvimento de aplicações de análise de dados (Analytics), BI (Business Inteligence), Desenvolvimento para bancos de dados SQL Server, conhecimento dos recursos administrativos (SQL Agent, Integration Services, Jobs SQL, T-SQL, DDL), MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cloud computing, Microsoft Azure, serviços Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Webservices, XML/XSD, API, JSON/Rest.

At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations- all united around one goal – to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers. While our company mission is to keep innovating global commerce, our internal mission is to #chooseaction, #beopen, #thinkcustomer, #gofurther and #wintogether

The Purpose:

The Cash Account team, part of PPRO’s Cash Flow domain, builds technologies that keeps our customers happy by simplifying and standardizing their cash movement through our banking network as well as offering new values as they grow their business whilst strengthening the relationship with our bank partners. We ultimately aim to unify our customers’ journey of their cash movement across all regions by absorbing all the complexity and offering standardized services and reporting.


What You Will Be Doing
  • Define and Lead Strategy:

Develop and communicate clear product statements and requirements for cash account aligning with PPRO’s business goals.

Own and evolve the cash account product portfolio, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and a strong value proposition for customers.

  • Innovate and Build Market-Leading Products:

Design and develop innovative cash account solutions that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

Improve automation and accuracy, reducing manual operations efforts for customers.

  • Drive Operational Excellence:

Own a multi-quarter roadmap, breaking down complex initiatives into shippable features that align with business priorities.

Define and track key product metrics to continuously improve banking performance and customer satisfaction.

Work closely with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and timely execution.

  • Enhance Stakeholder Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams, including Treasury, Compliance, Finance, and Customer Support, to ensure seamless cash account processes.

Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, gathering insights and ensuring alignment.

  • Build and Foster a High-Performing Team:

Collaborate closely with engineering and domain leadership to accelerate product innovation.

Champion a customer-centric mindset within the team, driving meaningful and impactful solutions.

What Success Looks Like
  • A scalable and efficient cash account platform that simplifies cost transparency and banking onboarding for customers.
  • Reduced manual treasury operations through automation, leading to improved accuracy and efficiency.
  • Strong alignment between product, engineering, and key stakeholders to accelerate development and innovation.
  • A high-performing, customer-focused team that delivers consistent results.
What We Are Looking For
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment.
  • Strong ability to define and execute product strategy, balancing long-term mission with immediate business needs.
  • Deep understanding of customer pain points and a passion for solving complex banking challenges.
  • Experience in running product discovery and defining success metrics to measure impact.
  • Experience in payments, banking, or financial technology, with a deep understanding of banking models and operations.
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements for engineering teams.
  • Expertise in leveraging data insights to optimize product performance.
  • Ability to create and track product metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Ability to influence and inspire teams, drive collaboration, and generate buy-in for product initiatives.
  • Proven track record of working closely with engineering, finance, and operational teams to deliver impactful solutions.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Deep technical knowledge with experience working across multiple engineering teams.
  • Prior experience in banking, treasury operations, pricing models, or payout systems.
  • Strong analytical skills to size opportunities and measure product impact effectively.

What we offer:

Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.

Learning and Development - We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

description:
Job description

Se você é da turma que adora criar produtos que fazem a diferença, vibra quando vê um impacto real no negócio e não tem medo de colocar a mão na massa (com IA, dados e tudo que estiver à disposição) — vem com a gente!

Aqui na Suno, estamos em busca de um(a)Product Manager com espírito de dono e paixão por resolver problemas. Alguém que tenha foco total no impacto para o negócio, mas que também valorize boas práticas, tecnologia e uma experiência incrível pro usuário.

Somos uma empresa em constante movimento — crescer, testar, aprender rápido, mudar quando necessário, sem medo de errar (desde que a gente erre rápido e com responsabilidade!).

Se você gosta de ambiente dinâmico, autonomia de verdade e espaço pra colocar suas ideias em prática, essa vaga pode ser pra você.


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia:

  • Cocriação de soluções com foco em impacto real, lado a lado com o time de tecnologia e stakeholders.
  • Usar IA e ferramentas modernas (no-code, low-code...) pra acelerar entregas e evitar complexidade desnecessária.
  • Priorizar eficiência e entregas incrementais — aqui, o foco é no que realmente gera valor pro negócio e pro cliente.
  • Tomar decisões técnicas com base em impacto (não em preferência pessoal ou stack fixa).
  • Ser o elo entre produto, tecnologia e áreas de negócio, garantindo fluidez e colaboração.
  • Ajudar a manter o ambiente de trabalho produtivo e saudável: boas práticas, automações e qualidade nas entregas.
  • Garantir comunicação contínua com o time e stakeholders, com total visibilidade do que está sendo feito.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Alta capacidade de comunicação: você vai participar ativamente das discussões e precisa manter o time alinhado e engajado.
  • Protagonismo e ownership: aqui, a gente valoriza quem assume e resolve, com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Mentalidade inconformada e orientada à entrega: nada de “é assim que sempre foi”. Por aqui, queremos gente que questione, busque o melhor caminho e gere impacto real.
  • Abertura ao novo: testar, aprender e incorporar novas tecnologias faz parte do dia a dia (sim, IA também!).
  • Colaboração real: você será ponte entre diferentes áreas — sucesso do produto aqui é trabalho em equipe.
  • Capacidade de julgamento técnico de negócio: saber quando simplificar é tão importante quanto saber quando investir em uma solução mais robusta.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com entregas rápidas e impactantes (MVPs, protótipos, experimentos...).
  • Familiaridade com IA (ex: ChatGPT, Lovable, N8N...).
  • Boa visão de tecnologia e produtos digitais — não precisa ser dev, mas tem que entender bem o que é viável e o que gera valor.
  • Postura protagonista e alta capacidade de organização em ambiente dinâmico.

Vai se destacar se tiver:

  • Participação em projetos com foco em IA aplicada.
  • Histórico de atuação próxima a produto, marketing e/ou dados.
  • Forte capacidade de navegação em ambiente de mudança e crescimento acelerado.

Additional information

O que você ganha jogando no nosso time:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, pra cuidar bem de você.
  • Seguro de vida, porque segurança também é qualidade de vida.
  • Desconto no Wellhub (Gympass) e no Zenklub — corpo e mente em dia!
  • Parcerias institucionais que dão aquela força extra em cursos, serviços e mais.
