title: Senior AdministrativeAssistant
description:
Job Description

Na IPS, somos líderes globais no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras para consultoria, arquitetura, engenharia, controles de projetos, aquisição, gerenciamento de construção e CQV de instalações tecnicamente complexas, principalmente no setor de ciências biológicas. Estamos procurando um Assistente Administrativo Sênior dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe em nosso escritório localizado em São Paulo, Brasil.

Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas. Inglês fluente para comunicação com stakeholders internacionais, leitura de documentação técnica e suporte a relatórios e apresentações em língua inglesa.
Principais Atribuições:

  • Atender e direcionar chamadas telefônicas, e-mails e correspondências, com postura profissional e fluência em inglês, garantindo comunicação eficiente com clientes, fornecedores e parceiros nacionais e internacionais.
  • Recepcionar visitantes, fornecedores e equipes externas, oferecendo suporte logístico e administrativo a colaboradores internos e engenheiros.
  • Gerenciar o controle de suprimentos de escritório, materiais técnicos e equipamentos, atuando preventivamente na reposição e organização de estoques.
  • Manter áreas comuns organizadas, coordenando os materiais de escritório e limpeza para bom funcionamento da estrutura de apoio.
  • Criar, atualizar e manter bancos de dados administrativos e técnicos, sistemas de arquivamento (físico e digital), relatórios, registros e documentos de projeto.
  • Utilizar com domínio ferramentas como Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), além de sistemas corporativos como Ariba, Concur e SAP, aplicados à rotina de projetos de engenharia.
  • Apoiar ações de comunicação interna e institucional, incluindo apresentações, materiais de divulgação e eventos corporativos, com atenção à identidade visual e linguagem técnica.
  • Organizar viagens técnicas, visitas a obras e eventos externos, bem como gerenciar processos de reembolso e prestação de contas de despesas.
  • Prestar suporte na elaboração, revisão e formatação de propostas técnicas e comerciais, em português e inglês, garantindo conformidade com os padrões da empresa.
  • Auxiliar na gestão de contratos (clientes e fornecedores), controle de faturas, ordens de compra, notas fiscais e documentos administrativos vinculados a projetos de engenharia.
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, elaborando atas detalhadas, acompanhando pendências e contribuindo com o fluxo de informações entre áreas técnicas e administrativas.
  • Coordenar a logística e estrutura de eventos internos, treinamentos e reuniões com stakeholders, internos e externos.
    Atribuições Complementares:
  • Apoiar a gestão de contratos com fornecedores técnicos e prestadores de serviço, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, escopos e condições contratuais.
  • Atuar no controle e apresentação de indicadores administrativos e operacionais relacionados a projetos e desempenho da área.
  • Colaborar na implementação e atualização de processos internos, fluxos administrativos e políticas da qualidade.
  • Servir como elo entre os times técnicos (engenharia, projetos, produção) e as áreas de apoio (financeiro, compras, RH, jurídico), facilitando a integração das atividades.
  • Conduzir o processo de onboarding de novos colaboradores, especialmente estagiários e engenheiros juniores, apoiando na logística de integração e acesso a ferramentas corporativas.
  • Garantir a confidencialidade, organização e rastreabilidade de todos os documentos sob sua responsabilidade, com foco em compliance e boas práticas de gestão da informação.

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Administrative Assistant to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle and direct phone calls, emails, and correspondence professionally and in fluent English, ensuring efficient communication with clients, suppliers, and national and international partners.
  • Welcome visitors, suppliers, and external teams, providing logistical and administrative support to internal staff and engineers.
  • Manage the control of office supplies, technical materials, and equipment, ensuring timely restocking and organized inventory.
  • Maintain organized common areas and coordinate the supply of office and cleaning materials to support operational routines.
  • Create, update, and maintain administrative and technical databases, physical and digital filing systems, reports, records, and project documentation.
  • Proficiently use Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as corporate systems such as Ariba, Concur, and SAP, in support of engineering project routines.
  • Support internal and institutional communication activities, including presentations, marketing materials, and corporate events, while adhering to branding and technical standards.
  • Organize business travel, technical visits to construction sites, and external events, as well as manage reimbursement and expense reporting processes.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and formatting of technical and commercial proposals in both Portuguese and English, ensuring compliance with company standards.
  • Support contract management (clients and suppliers), invoice control, purchase orders, and administrative documents related to engineering projects.
  • Participate in project meetings by drafting detailed minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating communication between technical and administrative teams.
  • Coordinate logistics and structure for internal events, training sessions, and meetings with internal and external stakeholder

    Additional Responsibilities:
  • Support the management of contracts with technical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with deadlines, scopes, and contractual terms.
  • Assist in controlling and presenting administrative and operational indicators related to projects and departmental performance.
  • Collaborate in the implementation and continuous improvement of internal processes, administrative workflows, and quality policies.
  • Serve as a link between technical teams (engineering, projects, production) and support departments (finance, procurement, HR, legal), promoting integration and workflow efficiency.
  • Manage the onboarding process for new employees, especially interns and junior engineers, by organizing logistics, documentation, and access to corporate tools.
  • Ensure the confidentiality, organization, and traceability of all documents under your responsibility, with a focus on compliance and best practices in information management.

Only candidates who meet the qualifications outlined in the job description will be considered by IPS.


Qualifications & Requirements
  • Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes
  • técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação com stakeholders internacionais, leitura de documentação técnica e suporte a relatórios e apresentações em língua inglesa
  • Professional with over 10 years of experience in administrative routines within the engineering sector, providing direct support to technical teams,
  • multidisciplinary projects, and corporate departments.
  • Fluent in English, capable of handling communication with international stakeholders, understanding technical documentation, and supporting the preparation of reports and presentations in English.

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway Company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. Its newest acquisition, Linesight, specializes in cost, schedule, risk, program, and project management services in various market sectors, including data centers, life sciences, and high-tech industries. With the addition of Linesight, IPS has over 3,000 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.
Specialties
Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPCMV and Staffing Services.

IPS is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer.

Nice to have

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Primary Purpose of this Position:
The role forms part of the Manager, Finance Operations leadership team and will contribute by delivering highly effective business partnership to our regional operations teams. In doing so this role will drive financial value in our operating costs being our future fuel for growth.
The role falls in to two critical areas of support:
○ Provide regional / central technical leadership and support to the Operations Finance Leadership team. In doing so act as first point of escalation on problem solving and/or autonomously leading projects or project steps. Performs wide variety of Plant Finance related tasks and financial analyses
○ Provide back-up coverage / additional support to tasks performed by the Plant Finance Supervisors at the manufacturing plants of the region
What will you be responsible for?
• Acts as a trusted business partner to the Operation teams to support decision making and driving financial value in the form of EVA performance improvement
• In support of the above – oversee and manage regional level reporting / consolidation of monthly, quarterly and YTD financial related KPI performance (via standardized Ball Operational Excellence routines)
• Assist the Manager, Finance Operations in the consolidated and interpretation of analysis of the month end financial close results, annual operating plan (AOP) cycle and quarterly reforecasts (3+9, 6+6 & 9+3)
• Assist the Manager, Finance Operation in analysing spending trends to identify opportunities
• Provide back-up coverage / additional support to tasks performed by the Plant Finance Supervisors at the manufacturing plants of the region. These tasks will include the following:
○ Analyse the month end financial close results and communicate results
○ Development of annual operating plan (AOP)
○ Quarterly refresh of annual operating plan (AOP) being the 3+9, 6+6 or 9+3 forecast
○ “In month” monthly refresh of financial forecasts (often referred to as the POV)

description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: you have experience in leading and developing teams.
  • Customer Experience (CX) and Quality Assurance (QA) experience: Proven experience in monitoring CX operations, with a focus on efficiency and quality improvement, including quality monitoring, calibration, and performance management.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: You are data savvy and have experience in improving customer experiences.
  • CX & Quality Expertise: Proven experience in Customer Experience (CX) with a track record of driving quantifiable improvements in key metrics like CSAT, NPS, and CES.
  • Advanced Data Analysis: Highly proficient in Excel (PivotTables, Charts, statistical functions) for large, complex datasets, ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and experience in SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Python as a plus.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Methodologies: Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, COPC or other quality certifications a strong advantage.
  • AI Enthusiast: Eager to explore and apply Artificial Intelligence to enhance quality processes and agent performance.
  • Strategic & Influential Leader: Strong leadership presence, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders while anticipating future trends and developing long-term strategies.
  • Data-driven and Analytical: Leverages a robust analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Deeply dedicated to enhancing the customer experience and influencing others to prioritize customer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Explains complex changes clearly to diverse audiences, concisely summarizing data and insights, telling compelling stories, and presenting impactful recommendations.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues and implements solutions to prevent negative customer impacts. Able to turn incomplete or ambiguous inputs into clear action plans.
  • Highly Collaborative: Works effectively with various teams and influences stakeholders, building strong relationships across departments.
  • Adaptable & Dynamic: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and readily adapts to changing business needs and priorities.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proficiency in English and leadership experienceare mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

title: ASSISTENTE AMBIENTAL Santa Luzia - MG Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Auxiliar o desenvolvimento de serviços de monitoramento ambiental e gerenciamento de resíduos, envolvendo documentação, atividades de laboratório de análises de resíduos, e também, dos recursos naturais (água, ar, solo), comprometidos pelas operações dos aterros sanitários, realizando vistorias, análises técnicas programações de rotinas operacionais, análises de causas/efeitos de condições e riscos ambientais, avaliando os aspectos legais aplicáveis, elaborando relatórios, entre outros serviços técnicos, de modo a contribuir para o cumprimento da legislação ambiental aplicável.


Main responsibilities

  • Acompanhar a emissão e tramitação dos documentos que tratam das movimentações de resíduos, tais como manifestos, notas fiscais, conhecimentos de transporte, etc, avaliando os aspectos técnico-legais aplicáveis, para garantir a conformidade com a legislação ambiental;
  • Apoiar a programação das vistorias aos locais de movimentações de resíduos, tais como drenagens de chorume, etc, envolvendo levantamentos de atividades operacionais e processos, visando validar o cumprimento da legislação ambiental;
  • Auxiliar as análises técnicas de causa/efeito de condições e riscos ambientais, à luz da legislação, propondo processos de prevenção/preservação ambiental ou ações de mitigação ou remediação que venham neutralizar os danos ambientais, causados nas operações dos aterros sanitários;
  • Contribuir para identificar e preparar procedimentos de proteção ao solo, lençol freático, ar atmosférico e água, atentando para os ditames legais, visando contribuir para a normatização de controles ambientais e gerenciamento dos resíduos;
  • Participar, junto ao superior, da implantação ou implementação de rotinas operacionais e de laboratório, fazendo cumprir os procedimentos preventivos ou corretivos, para remediar danos causados ao meio ambiente;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar na avaliação os trabalhos de administração do laboratório, envolvendo estoques, orçamentos, custos e despesas de produtos químicos, processos de análises, registros, encaminhamentos e funcionamento dos equipamentos, fornecendo pareceres e recomendações, de forma a garantir credenciamentos, licenciamentos e o cumprimento da legislação aplicável;
  • Auxiliar equipes de laboratório, nos procedimentos de análises das amostras de resíduos, fazendo observar os parâmetros contratuais e as exigências legais, relativamente aos processos, organização e administração do laboratório e outros afins;
  • Ajudar a interagir com as unidades hierárquicas da empresa, buscando históricos de serviços executados e outros dados que conduzam à forma mais racional de programação dos trabalhos;
  • Apoiar na manutenção dos contatos com órgãos ambientais (INEA, Secretaria de Meio Ambiente, etc), prestando ou obtendo informações de restrições ambientais, protocolos, atendendo às eventuais notificações, acompanhando tramitação de processos e tudo mais que garanta a legitimidade das operações e à obtenção/manutenção dos licenciamentos requeridos;
  • Monitorar operações, projetos e processos específicos de campo, observando prazos, procedimentos, etc, efetuando registros, orientando gestores sobre criticidades e evidências de não conformidades, de forma a garantir o cumprimento de restrições ambientais ditados nas licenças e legislação;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração dos relatórios periódicos aos órgãos ambientais, atentando para prazos e formatações determinados, informando sobre rotinas e processos operacionais, para garantir o atendimento dos dispositivos constantes da licença ambiental;
  • Participar da elaboração de defesas de autos de infração/notificações, prestando informações solicitadas pelo setor Jurídico, providenciando documentos, justificativas, etc., visando contribuir para tomada de decisões gerenciais ou composição de respostas ao órgão ambiental;
  • Preparar e montar relatórios técnicos (estatísticos, de investigação ambiental, etc) descrevendo históricos, caracterizações dos recursos ambientais, interpretação dos dados, à luz da lei, para apresentação aos clientes ou aos órgãos ambientais;
  • Apoiar a ministrar treinamentos técnico-operacionais, de novos processos ou tecnologias, ou ainda, institucionais, visando disseminar conceitos ou instruções normativas;

Requirements and skills

  • Escolaridade Mínima: Ensino Superior completo ou em curso, em Gestão Ambiental, Química Industrial, Engenharia Química ou Ambiental, Biologia ou outro compatível. Formação em Direito (em conclusão ou concluído) agrega valor às funções, a critério do gestor da área.
  • Desejável conhecimentos da Legislação Ambiental aplicável.
  • Iniciativa, senso crítico e analítico, autocontrole e excelentes condições de relacionamento interno. Planejamento, organização e controle, foco no cliente, comunicação, trabalho em equipe completam o perfil.

  • Auxílio academia

  • Seguro de vida

title: Concept Outsource Lead (Creatures) Porto Alegre (Brazil) Epic Games Concept Art Senior (5+ years)
description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Concept Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative content provided by outsource partners. Reporting to the individual art lead(s) and working with the Outsource Manager, the Concept Outsourcing Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Epic review. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced concept artist, having worked in game studio pipelines before, and have a solid hands-on art background. The ideal candidate would be a talented concept artist who is able to communicate with outsource partners, including documenting existing pipelines, collecting or creating quality bar and technical example assets, collecting photo reference, creating mood boards, creating paint overs, and finally collaborating with other teams at Epic to ensure that concept art is of the highest quality and adequately supports the needs of those teams and the project.

In this role, you will

Work closely with the individual Epic Art Leads, Outsource Manager(s), and artists on the team to support external vendors

Create various concept designs for creatures that exist within the Fortnite ecosystem

Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors

If required, make any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner

Clearly communicate feedback to the outsource partner, and ensure those creative notes and goals are met. Inform leadership in the event that isn’t happening

Communicate and partner with internal Epic art staff to ensure that outsource concept art is clear and respects limitations from other disciplines

What we're looking for

Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship developing creatures

A keen eye for creature anatomy and an understanding of how this may affect downstream production groups

Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior Concept Artist role

An effective communicator, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate between internal and external teams and deliver clear and concise feedback

Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules

Understanding of other game art disciplines, their workflows and limitations (animation, character, environment, VFX)

Experienced working within a team and a high pressure production environment

A PLUS - Fluency in a language other than English, including Chinese, German, Spanish, Italian, or Russian

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

About the company

We develop cutting-edge games and cross-platform game engine technology!

Founded in 1991, Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment company and provider of 3D engine technology. Epic operates Fortnite, the world’s largest game with over 350 million accounts and 2.5 billion friend connections. Epic also develops Unreal Engine, which powers the world’s leading games and is being adopted across industries such as film and television, architecture, automotive, and manufacturing for visualization and simulation. Epic has over 2,200 employees across 35 offices worldwide with headquarters in Cary, North Carolina.

title: Governo do Estado nomeia 842 educadores
description:
A iniciativa tem como foco a valorização do magistério para garantir uma educação pública de qualidade.

O Governo do Estado publicou, na edição extra do Diário Oficial do Estado (DOE) desta sexta-feira (28), a relação dos 842 educadores aptos a serem nomeados, após aprovação e convocação no concurso público regido pelo Edital Saeb n° 03/2022. Este total refere-se as portarias de convocação, atrelados às 4ª, 5ª e última convocação para entrega de documentação para fins de nomeação.

A publicação destaca que são 387 professores e 151 coordenadores pedagógicos, que correspondem à 4ª convocação e mais 222 professores e 82 coordenadores pedagógicos, da 5ª convocação. Após a nomeação, a ser realizada pelo governador Jerônimo Rodrigues, os educadores terão o prazo de até 30 dias – contados da data da publicação do ato de nomeação no órgão oficial – para tomar posse.

Os candidatos nomeados para as escolas pertencentes ao Núcleo Territorial de Educação Salvador e Região Metropolitana (NTE 26) deverão comparecer à sede da Secretaria da Educação do Estado da Bahia, situada na Av. Luiz Viana Filho, nº 550, 5ª Avenida, Centro Administrativo da Bahia – CAB, 1º andar, sala 117. Já os candidatos aprovados para o interior do Estado deverão se dirigir para as sedes dos NTEs. É necessário apresentar documentação pessoal com foto.

O último concurso recebeu mais de 103 mil inscritos, divididos nos 27 Núcleos Territoriais de Educação, situados em Salvador e em outros 26 municípios do Estado. Foram ofertadas 2.113 vagas, sendo 1.806 para professores, 289 para o cargo de coordenador pedagógico e 18 para coordenador pedagógico indígena. Dos 4.923 habilitados no concurso, todos já foram convocados. Com a nova nomeação, já foram chamados 4.297 profissionais da Educação.

Our team consists of the very best; we believe in doing what is right for our customers and our employees. We provide our employees with the training, support and an opportunity for unlimited professional growth. Join us and become an EXPERT!

Position Summary:

The Dispatcher is responsible for coordinating the daily scheduling and dispatching of field technicians to job sites. This role serves as the primary point of contact between customers and field staff, ensuring efficient communication and timely service while prioritizing jobs based on urgency and availability. The ideal candidate will possess strong multitasking abilities, excellent customer service skills, and proficiency in dispatching software to streamline operations and meet service level agreements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answers incoming phone calls from customers and assists call or routes call to appropriate person

  • Receive and prioritize incoming service requests from customers, carefully documenting details related to the issue and location.
  • Utilize dispatching software to efficiently schedule and assign field technicians to job sites based on their availability, skill set, proximity to the location, and service call priority.

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships, and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Director, Product Sales – Open Finance Brazil Overview

The Open Finance team is looking for a talented Director, Product Sales to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

Your primary objective will be to cultivate strong relationships with our partners to accelerate profitable revenue growth. To achieve this, you will work closely with Mastercard’s internal customer account management and services teams to architect, price, negotiate, contract, build out, and implement innovative financial services offerings across various Open Banking use cases. A key success factor will be leveraging deep client relationships and capabilities across the broader Mastercard business, integrating Open Banking services into the overall account plans that address our clients’ most pressing strategies.

Role

  1. Develop and execute segment-level go-to-market strategy for Mastercard Open Finance services.
  2. Build strong internal relationships and communication channels within the local market sales, business development, and product teams.
  3. Align with the Global Open Finance teams and the broader Mastercard organization to ensure a collaborative, unified, and responsive interface to partner relationships.
  4. Analyze client needs, conduct research, develop solutions, and devise tactical plans to pursue business opportunities.
  5. Manage the entire sales cycle from opportunity identification through pursuit, proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
  6. Integrate Open Finance priorities and opportunities within the broader Mastercard strategic account planning framework.
  7. Build and manage a robust pipeline by identifying and selling to prospects.
  8. Successfully close new business through consultative and relationship-based selling.
  9. Achieve and exceed assigned quotas.
  10. Capture and share client feedback with Open Finance stakeholders to enhance product and technology management processes.
  11. Stay updated on industry and technology landscape to serve as a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and internal stakeholders.

All About You

  • Agility and desire to demonstrate depth and breadth of knowledge and skills daily.
  • High level of partner/client management experience, including in sales/business development roles.
  • Partner-driven with a proven track record of success through complex relationships and multi-tier distribution channels.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, capable of engaging C-level executives.
  • Solid understanding of top Open Finance use cases such as payments, identity, onboarding, and lending.
  • Strong working knowledge of technology, including APIs, cloud infrastructure, microservices, and SLAs.
  • Self-driven, proactive, motivated, and results-oriented.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks carry inherent risks. Employees and representatives must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.
  • Ensure confidentiality and integrity of accessed information.
  • Report any suspected security violations or breaches.
  • Complete all mandatory security trainings as per Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior CX Quality Manager
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior CX Quality Manager to our CX Global team in São Paulo !

Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: you have experience in leading and developing teams.
  • Customer Experience (CX) and Quality Assurance (QA) experience: Proven experience in monitoring CX operations, with a focus on efficiency and quality improvement, including quality monitoring, calibration, and performance management.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: You are data savvy and have experience in improving customer experiences.
  • CX & Quality Expertise: Proven experience in Customer Experience (CX) with a track record of driving quantifiable improvements in key metrics like CSAT, NPS, and CES.
  • Advanced Data Analysis: Highly proficient in Excel (PivotTables, Charts, statistical functions) for large, complex datasets, ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and experience in SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Python as a plus.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Methodologies: Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, COPC or other quality certifications a strong advantage.
  • AI Enthusiast: Eager to explore and apply Artificial Intelligence to enhance quality processes and agent performance.
  • Strategic & Influential Leader: Strong leadership presence, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders while anticipating future trends and developing long-term strategies.
  • Data-driven and Analytical: Leverages a robust analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Deeply dedicated to enhancing the customer experience and influencing others to prioritize customer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Explains complex changes clearly to diverse audiences, concisely summarizing data and insights, telling compelling stories, and presenting impactful recommendations.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues and implements solutions to prevent negative customer impacts. Able to turn incomplete or ambiguous inputs into clear action plans.
  • Highly Collaborative: Works effectively with various teams and influences stakeholders, building strong relationships across departments.
  • Adaptable & Dynamic: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and readily adapts to changing business needs and priorities.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proficiency in English and leadership experienceare mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Esta posição exige forte capacidade de articulação com stakeholders, visão sistêmica, habilidade de comunicação com alta liderança e domínio na criação de materiais executivos e instrumentos de monitoramento do sucesso da mudança; além de experiência em cenários de transformação tecnológica (ex: adoção de DevSecOps, Agilidade, etc) em cenários de ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais fim a fim.

Escopo do Programa

● Redução de débito técnico e obsolescência;

● Evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;

● Melhorias de qualidade de software e processos de desenvolvimento;

● Implantação e adoção de plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDP) com consequente evolução no modelo operacional de tecnologia;

● Conhecimento em frameworks como PROSCI/ADKAR, Lean Change ou similares.

● Habilidade comprovada em produção de apresentações executivas para níveis gerenciais e C-level.

● Experiência na criação de indicadores para monitoramento da mudança e tomada de decisão.

● Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis, DevOps e práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.

● Possuir visão sistêmica de estruturas e processos de tecnologia.

● Visão estratégica, poder de síntese com capacidade de executar no detalhe.

Diferenciais:

Localidade da posição:

Porque construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

A Meta transforma negócios com inovação e tecnologia, guiando empresas por uma jornada de evolução, que combina estratégia, serviços com inteligência artificial e execução com precisão. Com 35 anos de atuação, a Meta oferece um portfólio abrangente e ágil, em que cada solução é testada e aperfeiçoada em nossa própria operação, garantindo que os clientes recebam resultados reais, práticos e escaláveis.

title: Head of Digital Advertising Strategy New Sao Paulo, Brazil
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Head of Digital Advertising Strategy to join our team.

The Head of Digital Advertising Strategy position at Common Thread Collective (CTC) plays a key role in scaling our clients’ success. It centers on creating accurate forecasts to drive our clients toward their goals, followed by meticulously executing strategies to materialize these goals daily.

Your actions and decisions embody CTC’s Global core values, serving as a guiding force for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering tangible business results; it involves a proactive engagement with our clients, ensuring transparent communication regarding the actions undertaken and the performance relative to the forecasts. This ongoing dialogue not only fosters trust but also cements the partnership between CTC and its clients, guiding them through the complexities of media acquisition and strategic planning.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Head of Digital Advertising Strategy, you lead by example and set a high standard.

You view challenges as opportunities to excel and take great pride in your ability to drive results with precision and impact. At CTC, we embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take ownership, deliver excellence, and see things through to the end.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

TRAINING PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the training.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • As an Accelerator Strategist, you’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Head of Digital Advertising Strategy, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

  • Full ownership on projects and tasks assigned together with being able to work within a Team;
  • Able to document well processes and perform knowledge sharing sessions

  • Experience with modern cloud database technologies such as Snowflake ;

  • Experience with any programming language like Python or Java;

  • Development experience in both Microsoft , and Linux/Cloud environments;
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Tech Lead – .NET / DevSecOps

Resumo da Posição: Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead altamente capacitado(a), com forte atuação em .NET e DevSecOps , para liderar squads de desenvolvimento e apoiar a evolução dos processos de tecnologia em uma organização de consultoria especializada.

Esta posição combina expertise técnica , visão de arquitetura , liderança colaborativa e sólidos conhecimentos em gestão de projetos , sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade, segurança e performance das soluções entregues, além de promover práticas de automação, controle e visibilidade em tempo real dos projetos.

O profissional atuará como facilitador estratégico , liderando iniciativas de automação de processos, implementação de metodologias ágeis, waterfall ou híbridas, gestão de indicadores, coordenação de cadências, comitês e rituais, assegurando entregas de alto valor tanto em projetos internos quanto com clientes.

Também será responsável por implementar e evoluir práticas de governança tecnológica , garantindo o alinhamento estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e Gerência TI, com foco em conformidade, eficiência, segurança e inovação. A posição exige um perfil totalmente hands-on , com capacidade de desenvolver, orientar tecnicamente e tomar decisões críticas em projetos de grande impacto.

Linha de Reporte: Gerente de Tecnologia

Regime: Híbrido (a princípio, uma semana com 2 dias no escritório e 3 dias de casa, mas pode variar, dependendo das necessidades da empresa e principalmente dos projetos nos clientes que podem demandar estar presente dentro da estrutura do cliente)

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em TI, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação/MBA desejável.
  • Perfil totalmente hands-on, com capacidade de execução e liderança técnica.
  • Experiência em empresas de consultoria ou desenvolvimento de soluções para clientes externos.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, articulação com áreas de negócio e visão estratégica.
  • Vivência com gestão de indicadores (KPIs), automação de processos e governança de projetos.
  • Experiência sólida com .NET (C#), React Js, Web APIs, Entity Framework e LINQ.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure, incluindo App Services, Key Vault, Application Insights, etc.
  • Domínio de ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD em Azure DevOps.
  • Forte experiência com segurança de aplicações (DevSecOps) e princípios OWASP.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka), APIs REST, Azure Functions.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cosmos DB).
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com tecnologias de visualização de dados , como Chart.js , Highcharts , D3.js ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimentos básicos em UX/UI , com foco na melhoria contínua da experiência do usuário.
  • Desejável experiência com projetos de alta demanda , incluindo integrações, performance e usabilidade.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos para os setores financeiro, varejo ou meios de pagamento.
  • Conhecimentos em IaC (Terraform, Bicep) e monitoramento (Elastic, Grafana, App Insights).
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou publicações.
  • Conhecimentos em outras linguagens (JAVA, PHP e GO).

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente os squads em projetos baseados em .NET e Azure.
  • Implementar e manter pipelines CI/CD com Azure DevOps, garantindo builds, testes e deploys automatizados e seguros.
  • Integrar práticas de DevSecOps em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em segurança desde o código até a produção.
  • Realizar code reviews, orientação técnica e mentorias com foco em boas práticas, performance e segurança.

title: Operador(a) de Produção I
description:
Redução de emissões nocivas de veículos. Potencialização de futuros veículos. Dando nova vida aos metais usados.

Continuamos a fornecer soluções de materiais sustentáveis que atendem às megatendências globais e são essenciais para a vida cotidiana. Nossos produtos e serviços aceleram a transformação da mobilidade global, atendem à crescente necessidade de materiais avançados e permitem uma circularidade ainda maior para metais críticos. Somos a empresa líder em tecnologia de materiais circulares, cumprindo sua missão de criar valor sustentável por meio de materiais para uma vida melhor.

Com ambições como essa, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Sobre a produção PMR

Os recursos do planeta são escassos. A tecnologia de refino e reciclagem da Umicore dá aos metais usados um novo ciclo de vida. Somos especialistas no tratamento dos materiais mais complexos em todo o mundo. Nossos processos ajudam a agregar valor à economia circular, além de reduzir os impactos ambientais. Para recuperar a maior quantidade de metal a partir de diferentes tipos de material, não podemos ficar parados. Precisamos encontrar novas maneiras de trabalhar, descobrindo novas soluções e desenvolvendo novos processos. E é aqui que você entra.

O que você fará

Operar equipamentos tais como fornos elétricos, indução e a gás, moinhos, peneiradores, homogeneizadores, trituradores, filtros ambientais, equipamentos de transporte de materiais, controle de efluentes e sua recuperação.

Atuar na segregação e controlar a geração interna de recicláveis e não recicláveis.

Manter a organização e limpeza dos postos de trabalho, visando garantir a segurança operacional dos processos e atendimento dos requisitos produtivos para os diversos materiais a serem processados, recebidos dos clientes externos e internos, atendendo prazos e garantindo a qualidade do processo e produto.

Operar equipamentos providos de sistemas automatizados e supervisórios, realizando cálculos e ajustes de processo, quando aplicável.

Atuar no monitoramento dos filtros ambientais e equipamentos produtivos, com autonomia de parada do processo e acionamento dos dispositivos de emergência em caso de riscos à segurança e meio ambiente.

Realizar medições e testes para liberação de materiais, segregando os lotes até que ocorra a liberação dos mesmos para produção e também testes de segurança operacional, para garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e processos.

Receber, movimentar, identificar, segregar e estocar materiais e ferramentas auxiliares diversas, checando peso, nota fiscal, estado e condições.

Movimentar e abastecer os materiais para as linhas de produção, conforme definidos nas ordens de produção.

Pesar, embalar, identificar, estocar e organizar os produtos intermediários e finais, registrar as informações em formulários de produção, registrando os dados coletados na produção assim como ocorrências relevantes durante todo o processo produtivo e encaminhar para gestão, de forma a garantir a segurança do processo e a qualidade do produto final.

Amostrar os materiais processados, garantindo a correta preparação dos materiais para a coleta de amostras representativas para a correta analise e quantificação de metais.

Utilizar equipamento de movimentação de carga envolvendo inclusive pá carregadeira, empilhadeira a gás e elétrica para a realização das atividades produtivas.

Participar das liberação de segurança dos equipamentos e das áreas, de forma a atender os requisitos de segurança da empresa para que ocorram as intervenções de manutenção ou de engenharia assim como o retornos destes para produção.

Solicitar materiais no almoxarifado e abrir notas de manutenção corretiva, utilizando o sistema integrado, buscando contribuir com as demandas administrativas do dia a dia.

Ensino médio completo;

Experiência em indústria metalúrgica, química ou semelhantes na área de produção;

Desejável conhecimento no pacote office;

Carteira de habilitação (CNH) válida;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar das13:30 às 22:26 de segunda a sexta-feira.

O que oferecemos

Nosso objetivo é estar à frente. Não apenas para nossos clientes, mas também para nossos funcionários. É por esse motivo que buscamos um ambiente colaborativo no qual todos possamos ter sucesso, promovendo uma cultura de compartilhamento de ideias, desenvolvimento de nossa capacidade e avanço em nossas carreiras. Estamos empenhados na construção de uma cultura inclusiva que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todos, independentemente de suas origens. Como seria de esperar de uma empresa líder mundial, também recompensaremos sua contribuição com salários e benefícios competitivos. Com tudo isso e muito mais, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Umicore, nos empenhamos na construção de um local de trabalho inclusivo e diverso que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todas as pessoas. Contratamos, independente de gênero, religião, raça, nacionalidade,etnia, origem cultural, grupo social, deficiência, orientação sexual, estado civil, idade e opinião política.

Valorizamos a singularidade de cada pessoa e acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamento nos ajuda a encontrar as soluções certas em um ambiente competitivo e dinâmico, afinal equipes diversificadas contribuem para ambientes mais criativos e inovadores e garantem o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, tornando a Umicore um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

Se você compartilha os mesmos valores inscreva-se para fazer parte da nossa equipe.

title: Pensions Implementation Technician
description:
Description

We are recruiting an experienced Pensions Implementation Technician with a proven track record of using technology and strong knowledge of data extraction, manipulation, and transformation to help clients resolve challenges with their pensions data.

The successful candidate will have experience in working with various pensions administration platforms and transferring of member data from those platforms, excellent knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and Excel. They will be able to assess the difficulties that a client’s data will present, then design and implement software tools and accompanying processes to resolve those challenges in a clearly documented and risk-managed way.

We are looking for a self-starter with plenty of energy who works and communicates well with the team. In addition to your own tasks, you will be expected to take responsibility for reviewing the programming work of others to ensure technical accuracy. Experience in the technology aspects of pension correction and rectification exercises, and data audits would be advantageous as well as hands-on experience in the software development cycle.

This role can be based out of our London, Reigate, Bristol, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds or Edinburgh office working hybrid.

WTW’s Project & Data Solutions team brings a depth of experience and flexible resources to deliver the right solutions no matter how complex the requirements or large the defined benefit (DB) pension scheme is. No data project is the same and the team create and delivers solutions for wide-ranging issues and a varied customer base.

Project & Data Solutions delivers the right, cost-effective strategies and solutions for the following:

  • Guaranteed Minimum Pension (GMP) projects
  • Auditing data, benefits and calculations
  • Bulk data rectification and benefit (re-)construction
  • Data cleansing and improving electronic data
  • Supervising the data workstreams for de-risking projects so data is an enabler rather than a barrier.

What can we offer you? As an industry leader, we offer a generous salary and an excellent benefits package including pension, life insurance, medical insurance, eye care voucher and flexible benefits including critical illness cover, dental cover and many other options. We provide a defined career path with varied career opportunities as part of a dynamic team, encouraging and supporting our colleagues to tailor their roles to match their passions, strengths and aspirations.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution. We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Practical experience of a range of DB pension administration platforms, with an understanding of their structures and the difficulties of manipulating the member data
  • Excellent SQL skills and understanding of relational databases, including best practices in their use
  • Strong Excel skills
  • An ability to review and propose solutions to challenges with pension data, including leading software development teams
  • An ability to deliver multiple projects concurrently
  • Used to working in a fast-paced commercial environment where delivery to deadlines, budget and scope management are important
  • A clear, concise and skilled communicator of complex technology issues to a broad audience – good at maintaining project documentation and audit trails
  • Ability to work both as solo and in teams and enjoys a fast-paced environment
  • An ability to foster and support the delivery of projects within a team environment
  • Inquisitive, self-starter attitude and ability to work using own initiative

At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment throughout our organisation. We embrace all types of diversity.

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email .
